creators.name: Kristina Höök
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher who moved affective computing towards affective loops and then founded soma design; author of Designing with the Body (MIT Press 2018).
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，把情感计算推向“情感回路”，随后开创了身体设计（soma design）；著有《Designing with the Body》（MIT 出版社，2018）。
creators.why: She defined soma design as a design program in which the designer's own trained, felt body-mind is the main instrument.
creators.why_zh: 她把身体设计确立为一套设计纲领：设计师自己经过训练、被亲身感受的身心，是最主要的设计工具。

creators.name: Katherine Isbister
creators.role: Professor of Computational Media, University of California Santa Cruz
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校计算媒体教授
creators.bio: Game and interaction designer who studies emotion, movement and social play.
creators.bio_zh: 游戏与交互设计研究者，研究情绪、动作与社交游戏。
creators.why: She co-created the Sensual Evaluation Instrument, a nonverbal, body-based way to report feelings.
creators.why_zh: 她参与创造了感官评估工具（SEI），一种用身体、非语言的方式报告感受的工具。

creators.name: Jonas Löwgren
creators.role: Professor of Interaction and Information Design, Linköping University
creators.role_zh: 林雪平大学交互与信息设计教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher known for work on design knowledge and interaction aesthetics.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，以设计知识与交互美学研究著称。
creators.why: With Höök he framed 'strong concepts', the intermediate-level knowledge that soma design uses to share what it learns.
creators.why_zh: 他与 Höök 提出“强概念”，身体设计借这种中间层知识分享它的发现。

creators.name: Andrés Lucero
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, Aalto University
creators.role_zh: 阿尔托大学交互设计教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher working on participatory, playful and first-person design methods.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，研究参与式、游戏化与第一人称的设计方法。
creators.why: He gathered HCI's first-person methods under one banner with 'A Sample of One'.
creators.why_zh: 他以“A Sample of One”把人机交互中的第一人称方法汇聚到一起。

creators.name: Audrey Desjardins
creators.role: Associate Professor, School of Art + Art History + Design, University of Washington
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学艺术、艺术史与设计学院副教授
creators.bio: Design researcher who works through autobiographical design and living with prototypes at home.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，通过自传式设计和在家中与原型共同生活来做研究。
creators.why: Her work spells out what it takes for designers to use their own lived experience as research data.
creators.why_zh: 她的研究讲清楚了设计师把自己的生活经验当作研究数据需要什么。

creators.name: Carman Neustaedter
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学交互艺术与技术学院教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher on domestic and family technologies and telepresence.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究家庭与亲人之间的技术以及远程临场。
creators.why: With Phoebe Sengers he named autobiographical design as a legitimate HCI research method.
creators.why_zh: 他与 Phoebe Sengers 一起把自传式设计确立为正当的人机交互研究方法。

creators.name: Phoebe Sengers
creators.role: Professor of Information Science and Science & Technology Studies, Cornell University
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔大学信息科学与科学技术研究教授
creators.bio: Critical technical practitioner who brought reflective design and defamiliarization into HCI.
creators.bio_zh: 批判性技术实践者，把反思性设计与陌生化引入人机交互。
creators.why: Her 'making strange' and reflective design work gave soma design its first HCI vocabulary for estrangement.
creators.why_zh: 她的“陌生化”与反思性设计研究，为身体设计提供了最早的人机交互陌生化语汇。

creators.name: Genevieve Bell
creators.role: Anthropologist; former Intel Fellow and Director of the School of Cybernetics, Australian National University
creators.role_zh: 人类学家；前英特尔院士，澳大利亚国立大学控制论学院前院长
creators.bio: Cultural anthropologist who studied technology in everyday life across cultures.
creators.bio_zh: 文化人类学家，研究不同文化日常生活中的技术。
creators.why: She co-wrote 'Making by making strange', which taught HCI to defamiliarize the ordinary.
creators.why_zh: 她是《Making by making strange》的第一作者，这篇论文教会人机交互把平常之物陌生化。

creators.name: Dag Svanæs
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
creators.role_zh: 挪威科技大学（NTNU）交互设计教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher who brought Merleau-Ponty's phenomenology of the lived body into interaction design.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，把 Merleau-Ponty 关于活的身体的现象学带入交互设计。
creators.why: He shows how designers can use their own bodies, in different points of view and tenses, as a design resource.
creators.why_zh: 他展示了设计师如何以不同视角和时态，把自己的身体当作设计资源。

creators.name: Anna Ståhl
creators.role: Senior Researcher, RISE Research Institutes of Sweden
creators.role_zh: 瑞典研究院（RISE）高级研究员
creators.bio: Interaction designer in Höök's group who co-designed the Soma Mat, Breathing Light and many soma design workshops.
creators.bio_zh: Höök 团队的交互设计师，参与设计了 Soma Mat、Breathing Light 与许多身体设计工作坊。
creators.why: She articulates how soma designers sketch with their own bodies and what counts as rigour in doing so.
creators.why_zh: 她阐明了身体设计师如何用自己的身体画草图，以及这样做时何为严谨。

creators.name: Vasiliki Tsaknaki
creators.role: Associate Professor, IT University of Copenhagen
creators.role_zh: 哥本哈根信息技术大学副教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher working on biodata, somaesthetics, crafting and more-than-human bodies.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，关注生物数据、身体美学、手工制作与超越人类的身体。
creators.why: She helped turn soma design into a teachable practice and biodata into felt 'somadata'.
creators.why_zh: 她帮助把身体设计变成可以教授的实践，也把生物数据变成可被感受的“身体数据（somadata）”。

creators.name: Madeline Balaam
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计教授
creators.bio: Feminist HCI researcher working on women's health, intimate care and soma design.
creators.bio_zh: 女性主义人机交互研究者，研究女性健康、亲密照护与身体设计。
creators.why: She brings feminist and intimate-care concerns into soma design methods and teaching.
creators.why_zh: 她把女性主义与亲密照护的关切带入身体设计的方法与教学。

creators.name: Kristina Mah
creators.role: Design researcher, The University of Sydney
creators.role_zh: 悉尼大学设计研究者
creators.bio: Design researcher who studies contemplative and compassion practices as a way to train designers' self-observation.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究如何以冥想与慈悲修习训练设计师的自我观察。
creators.why: She shows how contemplative training can make first-person soma design research more careful.
creators.why_zh: 她展示了冥想训练如何让第一人称的身体设计研究更细致可靠。

creators.name: Lian Loke
creators.role: Associate Professor, Design Lab, The University of Sydney
creators.role_zh: 悉尼大学设计实验室副教授
creators.bio: Interaction designer and performance-maker who works with the moving, feeling body in design.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师与表演创作者，在设计中与运动、感受着的身体一起工作。
creators.why: Her 'Moving and Making Strange' gave movement-based and soma design a practical method for estrangement.
creators.why_zh: 她的“Moving and Making Strange”为基于动作的设计与身体设计提供了一套可操作的陌生化方法。

creators.name: Toni Robertson
creators.role: Emeritus Professor of Interaction Design, University of Technology Sydney
creators.role_zh: 悉尼科技大学交互设计荣休教授
creators.bio: Participatory design and CSCW researcher who grounded interaction design in embodied, phenomenological accounts of work and movement.
creators.bio_zh: 参与式设计与协同工作研究者，以具身的、现象学的方式理解工作与动作。
creators.why: She co-developed the Moving and Making Strange method and the 'feel dimension' of interaction.
creators.why_zh: 她共同发展了“Moving and Making Strange”方法和交互的“感觉维度”。

creators.name: Susan Kozel
creators.role: Professor, School of Arts and Communication, Malmö University
creators.role_zh: 马尔默大学艺术与传播学院教授
creators.bio: Dancer, philosopher and media artist who developed a phenomenological, performative research method for technology.
creators.bio_zh: 舞者、哲学家与媒体艺术家，发展出一种面向技术的现象学、表演式研究方法。
creators.why: Her book Closer models how to research technology from inside one's own dancing body.
creators.why_zh: 她的著作《Closer》示范了如何从自己跳舞的身体内部去研究技术。

creators.name: Lone Koefoed Hansen
creators.role: Associate Professor of Digital Design, Aarhus University
creators.role_zh: 奥胡斯大学数字设计副教授
creators.bio: Digital design researcher working on aesthetics, critique and embodied experience with technology.
creators.bio_zh: 数字设计研究者，关注美学、批判与技术中的具身经验。
creators.why: With Susan Kozel she devised 'embodied imagination', a method that mixes improvisation and design for intimacy.
creators.why_zh: 她与 Susan Kozel 提出“具身想象”，把即兴与为亲密而做的设计结合起来。

creators.name: Danielle Wilde
creators.role: Professor of Embodied Design, Umeå Institute of Design / University of Southern Denmark
creators.role_zh: 具身设计教授，于默奥设计学院 / 南丹麦大学
creators.bio: Designer and researcher working with the body, performance, wearables and participatory futures.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师与研究者，与身体、表演、可穿戴物和参与式未来一起工作。
creators.why: Her work analyses how estrangement in embodied ideation opens new design possibilities.
creators.why_zh: 她的研究剖析了具身构思中的陌生化如何打开新的设计可能。

creators.name: Oscar Tomico
creators.role: Associate Professor, Eindhoven University of Technology; Elisava Barcelona
creators.role_zh: 埃因霍温理工大学副教授；巴塞罗那 Elisava 设计学院
creators.bio: Design researcher on soft wearables, first-person and embodied design research.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究柔性可穿戴、第一人称与具身设计研究。
creators.why: He co-shaped first-person and embodied ideation methods in wearables design.
creators.why_zh: 他参与塑造了可穿戴设计中的第一人称与具身构思方法。

creators.name: Thecla Schiphorst
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学交互艺术与技术学院教授
creators.bio: Media artist, dancer and Certified Laban Movement Analyst who brought somatics into HCI.
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家、舞者与认证 Laban 动作分析师，把身心学（somatics）带入人机交互。
creators.why: Her idea of somatic connoisseurship treats the trained felt sense as a valid basis for experience design.
creators.why_zh: 她提出的“身体鉴赏力”，把经过训练的身体感受当作体验设计的正当依据。

creators.name: Jules Françoise
creators.role: CNRS researcher, LISN, Université Paris-Saclay
creators.role_zh: 法国国家科学研究中心研究员，巴黎萨克雷大学 LISN 实验室
creators.bio: Researcher in movement-sound interaction and interactive machine learning.
creators.bio_zh: 研究动作—声音交互与交互式机器学习。
creators.why: He studies how interactive sound can deepen kinaesthetic awareness, and how to ask people about it.
creators.why_zh: 他研究互动声音如何加深动觉觉察，以及如何询问人们的这种体验。

creators.name: Yves Candau
creators.role: Researcher and somatic movement practitioner, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学研究者、身体动作修习者
creators.bio: Movement practitioner and researcher who connects somatic practices, embodied cognition and interaction design.
creators.bio_zh: 动作修习者与研究者，连接身体修习、具身认知与交互设计。
creators.why: He brings somatic practitioners' ways of attending into interactive system design.
creators.why_zh: 他把身体修习者的觉察方式带进交互系统设计。

creators.name: Sarah Fdili Alaoui
creators.role: Professor of Art, Science and Technology, Université Paris-Saclay; choreographer
creators.role_zh: 巴黎萨克雷大学艺术、科学与技术教授；编舞家
creators.bio: Dancer, Laban Movement Analyst and HCI researcher working on movement qualities and dance with technology.
creators.bio_zh: 舞者、Laban 动作分析师与人机交互研究者，研究动作质感与舞蹈中的技术。
creators.why: She bridges dance knowledge and design research on the felt quality of movement.
creators.why_zh: 她在舞蹈知识与关于动作感受质感的设计研究之间架桥。

creators.name: Antti Oulasvirta
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, Aalto University
creators.role_zh: 阿尔托大学计算机科学教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher, early on in mobile and contextual design, later in computational models of interaction.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，早期研究移动与情境设计，后来研究交互的计算模型。
creators.why: His bodystorming case studies established designing by physically being in the situation.
creators.why_zh: 他的身体风暴案例研究确立了“亲身置身情境中”做设计的方法。

creators.name: Dennis Schleicher
creators.role: Design researcher and consultant; OCAD University Strategic Foresight and Innovation alumnus
creators.role_zh: 设计研究者与顾问；OCAD 大学战略预见与创新项目校友
creators.bio: Design researcher who wrote on bodystorming as a form of embodied designing.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，撰文把身体风暴阐述为一种具身的设计方式。
creators.why: He reframed bodystorming from role-play to embodied thinking.
creators.why_zh: 他把身体风暴从角色扮演重新理解为用身体思考。

creators.name: Marion Buchenau
creators.role: Designer, formerly IDEO
creators.role_zh: 设计师，曾任职 IDEO
creators.bio: Interaction designer who, with Jane Fulton Suri, described experience prototyping at IDEO.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师，与 Jane Fulton Suri 一起在 IDEO 阐述了体验原型方法。
creators.why: Experience prototyping made 'feel it yourself' a standard step in design practice.
creators.why_zh: 体验原型让“亲身去感受”成为设计实践中的常规步骤。

creators.name: Jane Fulton Suri
creators.role: Partner Emeritus and Chief Creative Officer, IDEO
creators.role_zh: IDEO 荣誉合伙人、前首席创意官
creators.bio: Psychologist and designer who shaped human-centred design research at IDEO.
creators.bio_zh: 心理学家与设计师，塑造了 IDEO 以人为本的设计研究。
creators.why: She championed learning through bodily, first-hand experience of prototypes.
creators.why_zh: 她倡导通过亲身、身体性地体验原型来学习。

creators.name: Elena Márquez Segura
creators.role: Associate Professor, Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
creators.role_zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学副教授
creators.bio: Interaction designer working on embodied and social play, movement and physical training.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师，研究具身与社交游戏、动作与身体训练。
creators.why: She developed embodied sketching, which puts moving bodies and play at the start of design.
creators.why_zh: 她发展了具身草图法，把运动的身体与游戏放在设计的起点。

creators.name: Laia Turmo Vidal
creators.role: Researcher, Universidad Carlos III de Madrid / KTH
creators.role_zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学 / 瑞典皇家理工学院研究者
creators.bio: Interaction designer researching technology for physical training, movement learning and embodied design methods.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师，研究身体训练技术、动作学习与具身设计方法。
creators.why: She develops methods and strong concepts for designing with trainers' and trainees' felt bodies.
creators.why_zh: 她为“以教练与学员的身体感受来设计”发展方法与强概念。

creators.name: Caroline Hummels
creators.role: Professor of Design and Theory for Transforming Practices, Eindhoven University of Technology
creators.role_zh: 埃因霍温理工大学“面向变革实践的设计与理论”教授
creators.bio: Design researcher on embodied, movement-based interaction and embodied sensemaking.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究具身的、基于动作的交互与具身意义建构。
creators.why: Her 'move to get moved' stance insists that designers must move their own bodies to design for movement.
creators.why_zh: 她的“动起来才能被打动”主张：为动作而设计，设计师自己必须动起来。

creators.name: Charles Windlin
creators.role: Researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院研究者
creators.bio: Designer-engineer in Höök's group who built the Soma Bits toolkit.
creators.bio_zh: Höök 团队的设计工程师，打造了 Soma Bits 工具包。
creators.why: He made soma design's materials — heat, vibration, shape-change — available as a hands-on toolkit.
creators.why_zh: 他把身体设计的材料——热、振动、形变——做成可上手的工具包。

creators.name: Miquel Alfaras
creators.role: Researcher, Universitat Jaume I / KTH
creators.role_zh: 海梅一世大学 / 瑞典皇家理工学院研究者
creators.bio: Engineer and researcher on biosignal acquisition and its use as design material.
creators.bio_zh: 工程师与研究者，研究生物信号采集及其作为设计材料的用途。
creators.why: He framed the turn from biodata to somadata: biosignals felt on the body rather than read on a screen.
creators.why_zh: 他提出从生物数据到身体数据的转向：生物信号应在身体上被感受，而不是在屏幕上被读取。

creators.name: Claudia Núñez-Pacheco
creators.role: Design researcher, Malmö University (previously KTH and The University of Sydney)
creators.role_zh: 马尔默大学设计研究者（曾任职 KTH 与悉尼大学）
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher working with somaesthetics, Focusing, micro-phenomenology and first-person methods.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，研究身体美学、Focusing（体会聚焦）、微观现象学与第一人称方法。
creators.why: She adapted Gendlin's Focusing into an introspective somatic method for designers.
creators.why_zh: 她把 Gendlin 的 Focusing 改造为设计师可用的内省式身体方法。

creators.name: Paul Tennent
creators.role: Associate Professor, Mixed Reality Lab, University of Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室副教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher on amusement rides, bodily experience and biosensing in extreme experiences.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究游乐设施、身体经验以及极端体验中的生物传感。
creators.why: He led the soma trajectories method for articulating how a felt experience unfolds over time.
creators.why_zh: 他主导了“身体轨迹”方法，用来说出一段被感受的经验如何随时间展开。

creators.name: Steve Benford
creators.role: Professor of Collaborative Computing, Mixed Reality Lab, University of Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室协作计算教授
creators.bio: Co-founder of the Mixed Reality Lab, known for performance-led research with artists and the trajectories framework.
creators.bio_zh: 混合现实实验室联合创始人，以与艺术家合作的表演导向研究和“轨迹”框架著称。
creators.why: His trajectories framework became the basis for soma trajectories.
creators.why_zh: 他的“轨迹”框架成为身体轨迹方法的基础。

creators.name: Claire Petitmengin
creators.role: Professor Emerita, Institut Mines-Télécom; member of the Archives Husserl, Paris
creators.role_zh: 巴黎电信矿业学院荣休教授；巴黎胡塞尔档案馆成员
creators.bio: Philosopher and researcher who developed the micro-phenomenological interview from Varela's neurophenomenology and Vermersch's explicitation interview.
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家与研究者，在 Varela 的神经现象学与 Vermersch 的“明述访谈”基础上发展出微观现象学访谈。
creators.why: Her interview method gives designers a rigorous way to help people describe felt experience moment by moment.
creators.why_zh: 她的访谈方法为设计师提供了严谨的途径，帮助人们一刻一刻地描述被感受的经验。

creators.name: Mirjana Prpa
creators.role: Researcher, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学研究者
creators.bio: Interaction designer working on breath, attention and immersive experiences.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师，研究呼吸、注意力与沉浸式体验。
creators.why: She brought micro-phenomenology into HCI design research and reported how experts use it.
creators.why_zh: 她把微观现象学引入人机交互设计研究，并报告了专家如何使用它。

creators.name: Karen Anne Cochrane
creators.role: Design researcher, Carleton University
creators.role_zh: 卡尔顿大学设计研究者
creators.bio: Design researcher working on body maps, wearables and emotion.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究身体地图、可穿戴与情绪。
creators.why: She turned body mapping into a generative tool for soma-based design.
creators.why_zh: 她把身体地图变成身体设计的生成性工具。

creators.name: Rachael Garrett
creators.role: Researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher on ethics, soma design and human-robot interaction.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，关注伦理、身体设计与人机器人交互。
creators.why: She developed felt ethics: ethical sensibility cultivated through the designer's body.
creators.why_zh: 她发展了“被感受的伦理”：通过设计师的身体培养伦理感受力。

creators.name: Kristina Popova
creators.role: Researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher on vulnerability, ethics and intimate data in soma design.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究身体设计中的脆弱性、伦理与亲密数据。
creators.why: She argued that vulnerability, not only protection, is an ethical stance in soma design processes.
creators.why_zh: 她主张：在身体设计过程中，脆弱性本身——而不只是保护——就是一种伦理立场。

creators.name: Jonas Fritsch
creators.role: Associate Professor of Digital Design, IT University of Copenhagen
creators.role_zh: 哥本哈根信息技术大学数字设计副教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher working with affect theory, atmospheres and sound in design.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，把情动理论、氛围与声音带入设计。
creators.why: He led the soma design study of silence as a way of estranging habitual sensing.
creators.why_zh: 他主导了以“静默”陌生化惯常感知的身体设计研究。

works.title: Designing with the Body: Somaesthetic Interaction Design
works.description: Höök's book that defines soma design: it tells how she learned Feldenkrais and horseback riding, walks through the Soma Mat, Breathing Light and other cases, and sets out a soma design manifesto, theory and methods.
works.description_zh: Höök 奠定身体设计的专著：讲述她如何学习 Feldenkrais 与骑马，逐一剖析 Soma Mat、Breathing Light 等案例，并提出身体设计宣言、理论与方法。
works.idea_en: Design starts from a body-mind trained to feel more finely; the designer's own soma is the first instrument of design, not an afterthought.
works.idea_zh: 设计始于一个被训练得更敏锐的身心；设计师自己的身体是第一件设计工具，而不是事后才考虑的东西。
works.method: Book (MIT Press, Design Thinking, Design Theory series) combining Shusterman's somaesthetics, first-person design accounts and a catalogue of methods such as estrangement, somatic training and soma-based material exploration.
works.method_zh: 专著（MIT 出版社“设计思维·设计理论”丛书），结合 Shusterman 的身体美学、第一人称设计叙述，以及陌生化、身体训练、以身体探索材料等方法。

paper.title: Designing with the Body: Somaesthetic Interaction Design

works.title: Somaesthetic Design
works.description: An interactions cover story that introduced somaesthetic design to a broad HCI audience, using the Soma Mat, heat and breath-driven light as examples of technology that turns attention inward.
works.description_zh: 《interactions》杂志封面文章，向广大人机交互读者介绍身体美学设计，以 Soma Mat、热感与呼吸驱动的灯光为例，说明技术如何把注意力引向身体内部。
works.idea_en: Technology can be designed to slow us down and help us feel our own body-mind more richly, instead of pulling attention outward.
works.idea_zh: 技术可以被设计成让我们慢下来、更丰富地感受自己的身心，而不是把注意力拉向外部。
works.method: Magazine essay drawing on Feldenkrais-inspired design workshops and prototypes built in Höök's group.
works.method_zh: 杂志文章，取材于 Höök 团队受 Feldenkrais 启发的设计工作坊与原型。

paper.title: Somaesthetic design

works.title: Somaesthetic Appreciation Design
works.description: The CHI paper behind the Soma Mat and Breathing Light that names design qualities for systems of somaesthetic appreciation: subtle guidance, making space and intimate correspondence.
works.description_zh: Soma Mat 与 Breathing Light 背后的 CHI 论文，提出“身体美学鉴赏”系统的设计品质：细微的引导、留出空间与亲密的对应。
works.idea_en: Systems for bodily awareness work when they guide lightly and leave room for the person's own felt sense to lead.
works.idea_zh: 帮助身体觉察的系统，要轻轻引导，并为人自身的身体感受留出主导的空间。
works.method: Research-through-design with Feldenkrais-trained designers, heat and light prototypes, and first-person and user studies.
works.method_zh: 以设计为研究：由受过 Feldenkrais 训练的设计师制作热与光的原型，并结合第一人称与用户研究。

paper.title: Somaesthetic Appreciation Design

works.title: Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design
works.description: A 22-author paper in which soma designers each describe a first-person design case and together argue that the designer's own felt experience is a legitimate source of design knowledge.
works.description_zh: 22 位身体设计研究者各自讲述一个第一人称设计案例，共同论证设计师自己的身体感受是正当的设计知识来源。
works.idea_en: To design for felt experience, designers must first examine their own; first-person inquiry is disciplined practice, not self-indulgence.
works.idea_zh: 要为被感受的经验而设计，设计师得先审视自己的经验；第一人称探究是有纪律的实践，而非自我沉溺。
works.method: Collective paper that grew out of the CHI 2017 Soma-Based Design Theory workshop, gathering cases from breathing, dance, heat, sound and play.
works.method_zh: 源自 CHI 2017“Soma-Based Design Theory”工作坊的集体论文，汇集呼吸、舞蹈、热、声音与游戏等案例。

paper.title: Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design

works.title: Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case
works.description: A TOCHI article that uses a series of soma design projects to show what design looks like when it refuses the split between mind and body, self and other, subject and object.
works.description_zh: TOCHI 论文，以一系列身体设计项目展示：当设计拒绝心与身、自我与他者、主体与客体的二分时，会是什么样子。
works.idea_en: Feeling, thinking and moving are one process; methods that treat the designer's soma as data make that non-dualism practical.
works.idea_zh: 感受、思考与动作是同一个过程；把设计师的身体当作数据的方法，让这种非二元立场变得可操作。
works.method: Theoretical paper built from case projects by KTH and Nottingham teams, analysed as design strategies for non-dualistic design.
works.method_zh: 理论论文，基于 KTH 与诺丁汉团队的案例项目，把它们分析为非二元设计的策略。

paper.title: Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case

works.title: Soma-Based Design Theory
works.description: A CHI 2017 workshop where soma designers moved, touched and discussed together to work out a shared theory of soma-based design; its cases became the 2018 first-person paper.
works.description_zh: CHI 2017 工作坊：身体设计研究者一起动身体、触摸、讨论，尝试形成共同的身体设计理论；其中的案例后来成为 2018 年第一人称论文。
works.idea_en: Theory of soma design is built by doing it together with bodies in the room, not only by reading.
works.idea_zh: 身体设计的理论要靠大家带着身体在场一起做出来，不只靠阅读。
works.method: One-day workshop combining somatic exercises, sharing of first-person design cases and collective writing.
works.method_zh: 一天的工作坊，结合身体练习、第一人称设计案例分享与集体写作。

paper.title: Soma-Based Design Theory

works.title: Strong Concepts: Intermediate-Level Knowledge in Interaction Design Research
works.description: Defines strong concepts: design ideas that sit between a single artefact and a general theory, can be reused across designs, and are grounded in examples. Soma design uses them to share what it learns.
works.description_zh: 定义“强概念”：介于单个作品与普遍理论之间、可在不同设计中复用、以实例为依据的设计想法。身体设计借此分享它的发现。
works.idea_en: Felt design knowledge can be shared without flattening it into rules: name the interaction pattern and show the cases.
works.idea_zh: 被感受的设计知识可以分享而不必压成规则：命名交互模式，并给出案例。
works.method: Conceptual paper illustrated with strong concepts such as social navigation and seamfulness, later used for soma design concepts.
works.method_zh: 概念性论文，以社会导航、接缝可见等强概念为例；这一框架后来被用于提炼身体设计的概念。

paper.title: Strong concepts: Intermediate-level knowledge in interaction design research

works.title: Transferring Qualities from Horseback Riding to Design
works.description: Höök's autoethnography of learning to ride a horse: how rider and horse come to communicate through subtle shifts of weight and muscle, and which of those qualities design could borrow.
works.description_zh: Höök 学骑马的自我民族志：骑手与马如何借由重心与肌肉的细微变化相互沟通，以及设计可以借用哪些品质。
works.idea_en: Years of bodily learning with another living body reveal interaction qualities — subtlety, rhythm, mutual attunement — that screens rarely offer.
works.idea_zh: 与另一个活的身体共同学习多年，揭示了屏幕少有的交互品质：细腻、节奏与相互调谐。
works.method: First-person autoethnographic account drawn from the author's years of riding lessons, analysed for design qualities.
works.method_zh: 第一人称自我民族志，取材于作者多年的骑马课程，并从中分析设计品质。

paper.title: Transferring qualities from horseback riding to design

works.title: A Sample of One: First-Person Research Methods in HCI
works.description: A DIS workshop that gathered autoethnography, autobiographical design, soma design and other first-person methods to discuss their rigour, ethics and value in HCI.
works.description_zh: DIS 工作坊，汇集自我民族志、自传式设计、身体设计等第一人称方法，讨论它们在人机交互中的严谨性、伦理与价值。
works.idea_en: When the researcher is also the participant, the body that lives with the design becomes the instrument of knowing.
works.idea_zh: 当研究者同时是参与者，与设计共同生活的身体就成了认识的工具。
works.method: Workshop with position papers and hands-on sessions; it led to a TOCHI special issue on first-person methods (2021).
works.method_zh: 工作坊包括立场论文与实践环节，后来促成 TOCHI 第一人称方法特刊（2021）。

paper.title: A Sample of One: First-Person Research Methods in HCI

works.title: Autobiographical Design in HCI Research
works.description: Defines autobiographical design — building and living with a system you made for yourself — and shows through interviews with practitioners that it yields knowledge ordinary studies miss.
works.description_zh: 定义“自传式设计”——为自己做一个系统并与之长期共处——并通过访谈实践者表明，它能得到一般研究得不到的知识。
works.idea_en: Long, genuine use by the designer's own life and body surfaces the small frictions and pleasures that short studies never reach.
works.idea_zh: 设计师以自己的生活与身体长期、真实地使用，能发现短期研究触及不到的细小摩擦与乐趣。
works.method: Interview study with researchers who had designed for themselves, synthesised into features of the method.
works.method_zh: 对“为自己做设计”的研究者进行访谈，归纳出这一方法的特征。

paper.title: Autobiographical design in HCI research: designing and learning through use-it-yourself

works.title: Revealing Tensions in Autobiographical Design in HCI
works.description: Reflects on the tensions of autobiographical design — between researcher and participant, private life and publication, genuine need and research agenda — using the authors' own long-term projects.
works.description_zh: 借作者自己的长期项目，反思自传式设计中的张力：研究者与参与者、私人生活与发表、真实需要与研究议程之间。
works.idea_en: Using your own life as data demands care about what you expose and how honestly you report your own body and home.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的生活当作数据，就需要谨慎处理暴露什么，以及如何诚实地报告自己的身体与家。
works.method: Reflective analysis of the authors' autobiographical design projects (with Aubree Ball), structured as five tensions.
works.method_zh: 对作者（与 Aubree Ball）的自传式设计项目进行反思性分析，整理为五种张力。

paper.title: Revealing Tensions in Autobiographical Design in HCI

works.title: The Designer's Body as Resource in Design
works.description: Maps how designers use their own bodies in design by combining point of view (first, second, third person) with tense (past, present, future), and shows each combination in practice.
works.description_zh: 把视角（第一、第二、第三人称）与时态（过去、现在、将来）组合起来，梳理设计师如何在设计中使用自己的身体，并逐一举例。
works.idea_en: Imagining, remembering and enacting a felt experience are different bodily resources; a designer can switch among them on purpose.
works.idea_zh: 想象、回忆与演出一段身体经验，是不同的身体资源；设计师可以有意识地在它们之间切换。
works.method: Conceptual framework grounded in Merleau-Ponty and illustrated with student design projects and the authors' practice.
works.method_zh: 以 Merleau-Ponty 为基础的概念框架，并用学生设计项目与作者的实践加以说明。

paper.title: The Designer's Body as Resource in Design: Exploring Combinations of Point-of-view and Tense

works.title: Validity and Rigour in Soma Design: Sketching with the Soma
works.description: Describes 'sketching with the soma' — the iterative, felt trying-out of materials and movements on one's own body — and argues for what makes such first-person design rigorous and valid.
works.description_zh: 描述“用身体画草图”——在自己身上反复、亲身地试验材料与动作——并论证这类第一人称设计何以严谨、有效。
works.idea_en: The designer's felt sense can be trained, tested against others and made accountable; that is where the rigour of soma design lies.
works.idea_zh: 设计师的身体感受可以被训练、与他人对照、被问责；身体设计的严谨就在于此。
works.method: Analysis of several soma design processes, identifying practices of sensitisation, iteration and shared articulation.
works.method_zh: 分析多个身体设计过程，识别出敏化、迭代与共同表述等实践。

paper.title: Validity and Rigour in Soma Design-Sketching with the Soma

works.title: Closer: Performance, Technologies, Phenomenology
works.description: Kozel's book that researches telematic dance, motion capture and wearables from inside her own performing body, developing phenomenology as a hands-on research method.
works.description_zh: Kozel 的专著：从她自己表演着的身体内部，研究远程舞蹈、动作捕捉与可穿戴物，把现象学发展为一种亲身实践的研究方法。
works.idea_en: The researcher's dancing body can be a precise instrument for understanding technology, if its experience is described with care.
works.idea_zh: 只要细致地描述经验，研究者跳舞的身体就能成为理解技术的精确工具。
works.method: Book (MIT Press, Leonardo series) combining Merleau-Ponty's phenomenology with first-person accounts of the author's performances.
works.method_zh: 专著（MIT 出版社 Leonardo 丛书），把 Merleau-Ponty 的现象学与作者表演的第一人称叙述结合起来。

paper.title: Closer: Performance, Technologies, Phenomenology

works.title: Making by Making Strange: Defamiliarization and the Design of Domestic Technologies
works.description: Uses ethnographic and historical material to make the ordinary home look strange, so designers can question assumptions built into domestic technology.
works.description_zh: 借民族志与历史材料，让平常的家显得陌生，让设计师能够质疑家用技术中内置的假设。
works.idea_en: What is most familiar — including our own bodily habits — is hardest to design for until it is made strange.
works.idea_zh: 最熟悉的东西——包括我们自己的身体习惯——在被陌生化之前最难为之设计。
works.method: Defamiliarization strategies from literary theory and anthropology (cross-cultural comparison, historical reading, cultural critique).
works.method_zh: 借自文学理论与人类学的陌生化策略（跨文化比较、历史阅读、文化批判）。

paper.title: Making by making strange: Defamiliarization and the design of domestic technologies

works.title: Moving and Making Strange: An Embodied Approach to Movement-Based Interaction Design
works.description: A design methodology with tools for making habitual movement strange, so that designers can notice, describe and design from how movement feels, looks and is sensed by machines.
works.description_zh: 一套设计方法及工具，把惯常的动作陌生化，让设计师注意、描述，并从动作的感受、样貌以及机器如何感知它出发来设计。
works.idea_en: Only when a familiar movement becomes strange do we feel it again; that renewed feeling is the starting point for design.
works.idea_zh: 只有当熟悉的动作变得陌生，我们才会重新感受到它；这种重新的感受正是设计的起点。
works.method: Methodology with three perspectives (mover, observer, machine), using movement scores, somatic exercises and notation, built from dance-based design projects.
works.method_zh: 包含三种视角（动者、观察者、机器）的方法论，使用动作谱、身体练习与记谱，源自以舞蹈为基础的设计项目。

paper.title: Moving and making strange: An embodied approach to movement-based interaction design

works.title: Embodied Design Ideation Methods: Analysing the Power of Estrangement
works.description: Compares embodied ideation methods from three design practices and shows how estrangement — odd props, unusual constraints, unfamiliar ways of moving — opens up new design ideas.
works.description_zh: 比较三种设计实践中的具身构思方法，说明陌生化——古怪的道具、不寻常的限制、陌生的动作方式——如何打开新的设计想法。
works.idea_en: Disturbing how the body usually moves and senses is a reliable way to make designers notice possibilities they would otherwise overlook.
works.idea_zh: 打乱身体惯常的运动与感知方式，是让设计师注意到原本会忽略的可能性的可靠途径。
works.method: Comparative analysis of workshop methods by Wilde, Vallgårda and Tomico, identifying strategies of estrangement.
works.method_zh: 对 Wilde、Vallgårda 与 Tomico 的工作坊方法作比较分析，归纳陌生化策略。

paper.title: Embodied Design Ideation Methods: Analysing the Power of Estrangement

works.title: Teaching Soma Design
works.description: Reports soma design courses in which students did Feldenkrais-style body scans and movement exercises, then explored heat, vibration and shape-change on their own bodies before designing.
works.description_zh: 记录身体设计课程：学生先做类似 Feldenkrais 的身体扫描与动作练习，再在自己身上探索热、振动与形变，然后才开始设计。
works.idea_en: Somaesthetic sensitivity can be taught; slowing down with the body first changes what students go on to design.
works.idea_zh: 身体美学的感受力是可以教的；先与身体一起慢下来，会改变学生后来设计出的东西。
works.method: Analysis of several soma design courses and workshops with somatic exercises, material explorations and design briefs.
works.method_zh: 分析若干身体设计课程与工作坊，包括身体练习、材料探索与设计任务。

paper.title: Teaching Soma Design

works.title: Somatic Techniques for Experience Design (CHI courses)
works.description: Hands-on CHI courses — 'Body, Whys & Videotape' (2013) and 'Designing for Sensory Appreciation' (2020) — that teach HCI practitioners somatic exercises for designing and evaluating experience.
works.description_zh: CHI 实践课程——“Body, Whys & Videotape”（2013）与“Designing for Sensory Appreciation”（2020）——教人机交互从业者用身体练习来设计与评估体验。
works.idea_en: Designers can learn, in a few hours, to use breath, attention and movement as instruments for sensing experience.
works.idea_zh: 设计师可以在几小时内学会把呼吸、注意力与动作当作感知体验的工具。
works.method: Course with case studies, video and in-class somatic exercises drawn from Laban, Feldenkrais and other practices.
works.method_zh: 课程包括案例、视频与课堂身体练习，取材于 Laban、Feldenkrais 等实践。

paper.title: Designing for Sensory Appreciation: Cultivating Somatic Approaches to Experience Design

works.title: Move to be Moved
works.description: A CHI 2016 workshop where participants learned soma design by moving: somatic exercises, sharing of movement-based design cases and hands-on exploration.
works.description_zh: CHI 2016 工作坊：参与者通过动起来学习身体设计——身体练习、分享基于动作的设计案例、动手探索。
works.idea_en: You cannot learn to design for movement by talking about it; the designer's own body has to be moved.
works.idea_zh: 为动作而设计，靠谈论是学不会的；设计师自己的身体得先被触动。
works.method: Workshop organised by a large group of movement and soma design researchers, alternating movement practice with discussion.
works.method_zh: 由众多动作与身体设计研究者共同组织的工作坊，动作练习与讨论交替进行。

paper.title: Move to be Moved

works.title: Cultivating Kinaesthetic Awareness through Interaction
works.description: Draws on somatic practices and embodied cognition to propose how interactive systems — here movement sonification — can help people cultivate kinaesthetic awareness.
works.description_zh: 借鉴身体修习与具身认知，提出交互系统——此处为动作声音化——如何帮助人培养动觉觉察。
works.idea_en: Awareness of movement grows through attention practices; interaction can support that growth rather than replace it.
works.idea_zh: 对动作的觉察通过注意力练习而增长；交互可以支持这种增长，而不是取而代之。
works.method: Theoretical synthesis of Feldenkrais-style somatic education and enactive cognition, grounded in a movement-sound design study.
works.method_zh: 综合 Feldenkrais 式身体教育与生成认知理论，以一项动作—声音设计研究为基础。

paper.title: Cultivating kinaesthetic awareness through interaction: Perspectives from somatic practices and embodied cognition

works.title: Towards a Contemplative Research Framework for Training Self-Observation in HCI
works.description: Uses the researcher's own practice of Tonglen compassion meditation to propose a framework for training self-observation, so first-person HCI research can rest on cultivated attention.
works.description_zh: 以研究者自己修习“施受法”（Tonglen）慈悲冥想为例，提出训练自我观察的框架，让第一人称人机交互研究建立在被培养的注意力之上。
works.idea_en: Observing one's own body-mind is a skill; contemplative traditions offer tested ways to train it.
works.idea_zh: 观察自己的身心是一门技能；冥想传统提供了经过检验的训练方法。
works.method: Autoethnographic study of compassion cultivation combined with micro-phenomenological description, synthesised into a contemplative research framework.
works.method_zh: 对慈悲修习的自我民族志研究，结合微观现象学描述，提炼为冥想式研究框架。

paper.title: Towards a Contemplative Research Framework for Training Self-Observation in HCI: A Study of Compassion Cultivation

works.title: Experience Prototyping
works.description: Describes IDEO's practice of letting designers and clients live through a situation — wearing a pager, carrying a heart-patient's load — to understand how a design would feel.
works.description_zh: 介绍 IDEO 的做法：让设计师与客户亲身经历某个情境——佩戴寻呼机、背负心脏病人的负担——以理解一个设计会带来怎样的感受。
works.idea_en: The quickest way to understand a felt experience is to have it, in your own body, with rough props.
works.idea_zh: 理解一种被感受的经验，最快的方法是用粗糙的道具，在自己身上经历它。
works.method: Case descriptions from IDEO projects using role-play, props and simulated situations at different design stages.
works.method_zh: 来自 IDEO 项目的案例描述，在不同设计阶段使用角色扮演、道具与模拟情境。

paper.title: Experience prototyping

works.title: Understanding Contexts by Being There: Case Studies in Bodystorming
works.description: Case studies in which designers generated ideas while physically in the real setting — a bus, a home, a kindergarten — rather than in a meeting room.
works.description_zh: 案例研究：设计师身处真实情境——公交车、家中、幼儿园——而不是会议室里产生想法。
works.idea_en: Ideas come differently when the body is in the situation; being there is a way of thinking.
works.idea_zh: 身体置身情境中时，想法以不同方式出现；在场本身就是一种思考。
works.method: Four bodystorming case studies comparing idea quality and process with conventional brainstorming.
works.method_zh: 四个身体风暴案例，比较其与常规头脑风暴在想法质量与过程上的差异。

paper.title: Understanding contexts by being there: case studies in bodystorming

works.title: Bodystorming as Embodied Designing
works.description: An interactions article that presents bodystorming as embodied thinking: physically acting out a situation to generate and test design ideas.
works.description_zh: 《interactions》文章，把身体风暴阐述为具身的思考：通过亲身演出情境来产生并检验设计想法。
works.idea_en: Acting a scenario out with the whole body produces knowledge that talking and sketching on paper do not.
works.idea_zh: 用整个身体把情境演出来，能产生口头讨论与纸上草图得不到的知识。
works.method: Practitioner account with guidance for running bodystorming sessions (with Peter Jones and Oksana Kachur).
works.method_zh: 实践者经验总结，附有组织身体风暴的指引（与 Peter Jones、Oksana Kachur 合著）。

paper.title: Bodystorming as embodied designing

works.title: Embodied Imagination: A Hybrid Method of Designing for Intimacy
works.description: A method that combines dance improvisation with design scenarios so that participants imagine future intimate technologies through their own bodies.
works.description_zh: 把舞蹈即兴与设计情境结合的方法，让参与者借自己的身体去想象未来的亲密技术。
works.idea_en: Imagination is embodied: moving with another person makes possible technologies for intimacy felt before they are built.
works.idea_zh: 想象是具身的：与另一个人一起动起来，能让尚未造出的亲密技术先被感受到。
works.method: Workshops mixing improvisation scores, props and discussion, developed around wearable and intimate technologies.
works.method_zh: 工作坊融合即兴谱、道具与讨论，围绕可穿戴与亲密技术展开。

paper.title: Embodied imagination: a hybrid method of designing for intimacy

works.title: Embodied Sketching
works.description: A family of ideation methods in which designers and users sketch with their moving bodies, props and play in real settings, before any technology exists.
works.description_zh: 一组构思方法：在任何技术出现之前，设计师与用户在真实情境中用运动的身体、道具与游戏来画草图。
works.idea_en: Bodies at play are sketching tools; the felt, social qualities of an activity can be explored before they are engineered.
works.idea_zh: 游戏中的身体就是草图工具；一种活动被感受到的、社会性的品质，可以在工程实现之前就被探索。
works.method: Synthesis of several design projects (games, physiotherapy, dance) using bodystorming, embodied play tests and minimal props.
works.method_zh: 综合多个设计项目（游戏、物理治疗、舞蹈），使用身体风暴、具身游戏测试与极简道具。

paper.title: Embodied Sketching

works.title: Bodystorming for Movement-Based Interaction Design
works.description: Adapts bodystorming to movement-based interaction: participants explore movement, props and early technology together in the actual activity setting.
works.description_zh: 把身体风暴改造用于基于动作的交互设计：参与者在真实活动场景中一起探索动作、道具与早期技术。
works.idea_en: For movement design, the ideas worth keeping are the ones that feel right in the body during the activity itself.
works.idea_zh: 对动作设计来说，值得保留的想法，是在活动本身中身体觉得对的那些。
works.method: Analysis of bodystorming sessions in movement-based design projects (with Asreen Rostami).
works.method_zh: 分析基于动作的设计项目中的身体风暴环节（与 Asreen Rostami 合著）。

paper.title: Bodystorming for movement-based interaction design

works.title: Sensory Bodystorming for Collocated Physical Training Design
works.description: A bodystorming variant in which trainers and trainees try out sensory props — lights, sounds, vibrations — during real training sessions to imagine technology that supports learning movement together.
works.description_zh: 身体风暴的一种变体：教练与学员在真实训练课中试用光、声、振动等感官道具，想象支持共同学习动作的技术。
works.idea_en: Sensory feedback is best designed inside the shared activity, where trainer and trainee feel each other's movement.
works.idea_zh: 感官反馈最好在共同活动之中设计，在那里教练与学员能感受彼此的动作。
works.method: Workshops in circus and fitness training settings using simple sensory props, analysed for design qualities (with Annika Waern).
works.method_zh: 在马戏与健身训练场景中用简单感官道具开展工作坊，并分析设计品质（与 Annika Waern 合著）。

paper.title: Sensory bodystorming for collocated physical training design

works.title: Sketching Soma Bits
works.description: Describes the Soma Bits toolkit — small, soft modules that give heat, vibration and shape-change on the body, plus sensors — and how designers use it to sketch felt experiences directly on their skin.
works.description_zh: 介绍 Soma Bits 工具包——在身体上给出热、振动与形变的柔软小模块，外加传感器——以及设计师如何用它直接在皮肤上勾画被感受的体验。
works.idea_en: Designers need materials they can feel on their own body within minutes; that immediacy is what lets the soma lead the design.
works.idea_zh: 设计师需要几分钟内就能在自己身上感受到的材料；正是这种即时性让身体得以主导设计。
works.method: Modular hardware toolkit with actuators and sensors in fabric shapes, used and refined in workshops and courses (with Jarmo Laaksolahti).
works.method_zh: 模块化硬件工具包，把执行器与传感器装进织物外形中，在工作坊与课程中使用和改进（与 Jarmo Laaksolahti 合著）。

paper.title: Sketching Soma Bits

works.title: From Biodata to Somadata
works.description: Proposes 'somadata': biosignals such as muscle tension or breathing explored as design material through felt feedback on the body, instead of charts on a screen.
works.description_zh: 提出“身体数据（somadata）”：把肌电、呼吸等生物信号当作设计材料，通过身体上的感受反馈来探索，而不是屏幕上的图表。
works.idea_en: Data about the body becomes meaningful when it is felt by the body; turning biodata into somadata keeps experience and measurement together.
works.idea_zh: 关于身体的数据，只有被身体感受到才有意义；把生物数据变成身体数据，让经验与测量不再分离。
works.method: Design workshops where designers wore EMG and breathing sensors mapped to sound, vibration and heat, analysed as material exploration.
works.method_zh: 设计工作坊：设计师佩戴肌电与呼吸传感器，信号映射为声音、振动与热，并作为材料探索加以分析。

paper.title: From Biodata to Somadata

works.title: Crafting the Body-Tool
works.description: A body-centred perspective on wearables in which the body and the worn object are crafted together as one 'body-tool' through felt exploration.
works.description_zh: 一种以身体为中心的可穿戴视角：身体与穿戴物在亲身探索中被一起“打造”为一个“身体—工具”。
works.idea_en: A wearable is not added to the body; it becomes part of how the body feels itself.
works.idea_zh: 可穿戴物不是加在身体上的东西；它成为身体感受自己的一部分。
works.method: Design study with wearable props and somatic exploration, drawing on phenomenology and somaesthetics.
works.method_zh: 借助可穿戴道具与身体探索开展的设计研究，理论上取自现象学与身体美学。

paper.title: Crafting the body-tool: a body-centred perspective on wearable technology

works.title: The Sensual Evaluation Instrument
works.description: A set of eight smooth, abstract sculpted objects that people hold and arrange to show how they feel while using a system, as a nonverbal alternative to questionnaires.
works.description_zh: 一组八个光滑、抽象的雕塑物件，人们在使用系统时握着、摆放它们来表达感受，作为问卷之外的非语言选择。
works.idea_en: Feelings are bodily; letting people answer with their hands captures affect that words and rating scales flatten.
works.idea_zh: 情绪是身体性的；让人用手来回答，能捕捉到被语言和评分量表压平的情感。
works.method: Hand-sized sculpted objects made by an artist co-author, tested in user and cross-cultural studies (with Jarmo Laaksolahti).
works.method_zh: 由一位艺术家合作者雕刻的手掌大小物件，并在用户研究与跨文化研究中检验（与 Jarmo Laaksolahti 合著）。

paper.title: The sensual evaluation instrument: developing an affective evaluation tool

works.title: On Being Supple: In Search of Rigor without Rigidity
works.description: Proposes 'supple' interaction — social, emotional, bodily — and asks how to evaluate it with rigour but without the rigid metrics of task performance.
works.description_zh: 提出“柔韧的”（supple）交互——社会的、情感的、身体的——并探讨如何以严谨而不僵硬的方式评估它，不再依赖任务绩效指标。
works.idea_en: Evaluating felt, bodily experience needs methods as flexible as the experience itself.
works.idea_zh: 评估被感受的身体经验，需要与经验本身一样灵活的方法。
works.method: Position paper drawing on the authors' affective and movement-based systems (eMoto, SenToy, games).
works.method_zh: 立场论文，取材于作者的情感与动作系统（eMoto、SenToy、游戏）。

paper.title: On being supple: in search of rigor without rigidity in meeting new design and evaluation challenges for HCI practitioners

works.title: Self-Evidence: Applying Somatic Connoisseurship to Experience Design
works.description: Introduces somatic connoisseurship: using the trained felt sense of somatic practitioners as evidence in designing and evaluating experience.
works.description_zh: 提出“身体鉴赏力”：把身体修习者训练过的身体感受当作设计与评估体验的证据。
works.idea_en: The felt sense, when trained, is evidence; designers can learn to trust and articulate it.
works.idea_zh: 经过训练的身体感受就是证据；设计师可以学会信任并说出它。
works.method: Essay drawing on somatics (Laban, Feldenkrais, Body-Mind Centering) and the author's wearable and installation works.
works.method_zh: 论文取材于身心学（Laban、Feldenkrais、身心平衡技法 BMC）以及作者的可穿戴与装置作品。

paper.title: Self-evidence: applying somatic connoisseurship to experience design

works.title: Designing for Kinesthetic Awareness
works.description: Studies an interactive movement-sonification system and uses second-person interviews, inspired by micro-phenomenology, to reveal how people's kinesthetic awareness shifts.
works.description_zh: 研究一个动作声音化的交互系统，借鉴微观现象学，用第二人称访谈揭示人们的动觉觉察如何变化。
works.idea_en: Subtle changes in bodily awareness are invisible to logs and surveys; guided second-person inquiry can bring them into words.
works.idea_zh: 身体觉察的细微变化在日志与问卷中看不到；有引导的第二人称询问能把它们带入语言。
works.method: User study with a sonification system and second-person interview protocol, analysed for dimensions of kinesthetic experience.
works.method_zh: 以声音化系统开展用户研究，采用第二人称访谈流程，并分析动觉体验的维度。

paper.title: Designing for Kinesthetic Awareness: Revealing User Experiences through Second-Person Inquiry

works.title: The Micro-Phenomenological Interview
works.description: An interview technique that guides a person back into one specific past moment and helps them describe, in fine detail, what they felt and did — gestures, sensations, shifts of attention.
works.description_zh: 一种访谈技巧：引导人回到过去某个具体时刻，帮助他们细致描述当时的感受与动作——手势、感觉、注意力的转移。
works.idea_en: Much of felt experience is pre-reflective; careful questioning can bring it into awareness without imposing interpretations.
works.idea_zh: 许多被感受的经验是前反思的；细致的提问可以把它带入觉察，而不强加解释。
works.method: Second-person interview protocol (evocation of a singular experience, open 'how' questions, redirection from content to process).
works.method_zh: 第二人称访谈流程（唤起一次具体经验、开放的“如何”提问、从内容转向过程）。

paper.title: Describing one's subjective experience in the second person: An interview method for the science of consciousness

works.title: Articulating Experience: Reflections from Experts Applying Micro-Phenomenology to Design Research in HCI
works.description: Interviews expert practitioners on how they use micro-phenomenology in HCI design research, and draws out its strengths, pitfalls and training needs.
works.description_zh: 访谈在人机交互设计研究中使用微观现象学的专家，梳理其优势、陷阱与训练需求。
works.idea_en: Getting people to describe how an experience unfolds — not what they think about it — takes practice from both interviewer and interviewee.
works.idea_zh: 让人描述一段经验如何展开——而不是他们对它怎么想——需要访谈者与受访者双方的练习。
works.method: Qualitative study with experienced micro-phenomenology practitioners in design and HCI (with Philippe Pasquier).
works.method_zh: 对设计与人机交互领域有经验的微观现象学实践者的质性研究（与 Philippe Pasquier 合著）。

paper.title: Articulating Experience: Reflections from Experts Applying Micro-Phenomenology to Design Research in HCI

works.title: Articulating Soma Experiences using Trajectories
works.description: Soma trajectories: a way of drawing and describing how a felt experience unfolds over time — moments of attention, sensation and transition — for design and analysis.
works.description_zh: 身体轨迹：一种描绘并叙述被感受的经验如何随时间展开的方式——注意、感觉与转换的时刻——用于设计与分析。
works.idea_en: A soma experience has a shape in time; mapping that shape helps designers orchestrate transitions rather than single effects.
works.idea_zh: 身体经验在时间中有形状；描绘这种形状，帮助设计师编排过渡，而不只是单个效果。
works.method: Extends Benford's trajectories framework with first-person accounts from several soma design projects.
works.method_zh: 以多个身体设计项目的第一人称叙述，扩展 Benford 的“轨迹”框架。

paper.title: Articulating Soma Experiences using Trajectories

works.title: Body Maps: A Generative Tool for Soma-based Design
works.description: Body maps — outlines of a body that people draw and colour to locate sensations and feelings — used as a generative tool for soma design rather than only as a record.
works.description_zh: 身体地图——人们在身体轮廓上绘画、涂色以标出感觉与情绪的位置——被用作身体设计的生成工具，而不只是记录。
works.idea_en: Drawing where and how something is felt helps people notice and share sensations they could not put into words.
works.idea_zh: 画出“在哪里、以怎样的方式”感受到，能帮助人注意并分享说不出口的感觉。
works.method: Workshops with body-map templates, drawing materials and somatic exercises, analysed across several soma design studies.
works.method_zh: 工作坊使用身体地图模板、绘画材料与身体练习，并在多项身体设计研究中比较分析。

paper.title: Body Maps: A Generative Tool for Soma-based Design

works.title: Focusing for Interaction Design: An Introspective Somatic Method
works.description: Adapts Eugene Gendlin's Focusing into steps designers can use to attend to a vague bodily 'felt sense' and let it unfold into words, images and design ideas.
works.description_zh: 把 Eugene Gendlin 的 Focusing（体会聚焦）改造为设计师可用的步骤，去关注模糊的身体“体会”，并让它展开为词语、意象与设计想法。
works.idea_en: Meaning often begins as an unclear bodily feeling; staying with it patiently lets understanding and emotion emerge together.
works.idea_zh: 意义常常始于一种模糊的身体感受；耐心地与它待在一起，理解与情绪会一同浮现。
works.method: Method developed through first-person studies and workshops (following the authors' 2018 Design Journal technique paper).
works.method_zh: 通过第一人称研究与工作坊发展而来（延续作者 2018 年发表于《Design Journal》的技巧论文）。

paper.title: Focusing for Interaction Design: An Introspective Somatic Method

works.title: Tacit Narratives: Surfacing Aesthetic Meaning by Using Wearable Props and Focusing
works.description: Participants wear simple props and follow Focusing steps to bring tacit, bodily meanings of an experience into narrative.
works.description_zh: 参与者穿戴简单的道具，并按照 Focusing 步骤，把一段经验中默会的、身体性的意义讲成叙述。
works.idea_en: Objects on the body can act as handles for felt meanings that are otherwise hard to reach.
works.idea_zh: 身体上的物件可以成为把手，帮助我们触及原本难以触及的被感受的意义。
works.method: Workshop study combining wearable props, guided Focusing and narrative analysis.
works.method_zh: 结合可穿戴道具、引导式 Focusing 与叙事分析的工作坊研究。

paper.title: Tacit Narratives: Surfacing Aesthetic Meaning by Using Wearable Props and Focusing

works.title: Design Representations of Moving Bodies for Interactive, Motion-Sensing Spaces
works.description: Compares ways of representing movement for design — Labanotation, video, scores, personas of movement — and what each lets designers see about the moving body.
works.description_zh: 比较为设计表示动作的各种方式——Laban 记谱法、视频、动作谱、动作人物画像——以及每种方式让设计师看见运动身体的哪些方面。
works.idea_en: How a designer notates movement shapes what they can feel and design; choose representations that keep the mover's experience.
works.idea_zh: 设计师如何记录动作，决定了他们能感受到并设计什么；应选择能保留动者经验的表示方式。
works.method: Design case of an interactive motion-sensing space, with representations drawn from dance notation and interaction design.
works.method_zh: 以一个交互式动作感应空间为设计案例，采用来自舞蹈记谱与交互设计的表示方法。

paper.title: Design representations of moving bodies for interactive, motion-sensing spaces

works.title: Seven Principles to Design for Embodied Sensemaking
works.description: Seven principles for designing systems that support sensemaking through the body, grounded in enactive cognition rather than information processing.
works.description_zh: 七条设计原则，用于支持“通过身体理解意义”的系统，立足于生成认知而非信息加工。
works.idea_en: People make sense of the world by moving in it; design should support that bodily sensemaking, not bypass it.
works.idea_zh: 人通过在世界中运动来理解世界；设计应支持这种身体性的意义建构，而不是绕过它。
works.method: Principles derived from enactivism and phenomenology and illustrated with TU/e design projects (with Jelle van Dijk).
works.method_zh: 从生成主义与现象学中提炼原则，并以埃因霍温理工大学的设计项目为例（与 Jelle van Dijk 合著）。

paper.title: Seven Principles to Design for Embodied Sensemaking

works.title: Intercorporeal Biofeedback for Movement Learning
works.description: A strong concept: biofeedback shared between trainer and trainee, so that both can see or feel one body's inner activity and learn the movement together.
works.description_zh: 一个强概念：在教练与学员之间共享的生物反馈，让双方都能看到或感受到一个身体的内在活动，从而一起学习动作。
works.idea_en: Movement is learned between bodies; biofeedback works best when it supports that intercorporeal exchange instead of a lone user and a screen.
works.idea_zh: 动作是在身体之间学会的；生物反馈最有效的时候，是支持这种身体间的交流，而不是一个人对着屏幕。
works.method: Strong concept articulated from several training-technology design cases, with its design qualities (with Annika Waern).
works.method_zh: 从多个训练技术设计案例中提炼的强概念及其设计品质（与 Annika Waern 合著）。

paper.title: Intercorporeal Biofeedback for Movement Learning

works.title: Felt Ethics: Cultivating Ethical Sensibility in Design Practice
works.description: Argues that ethical judgment in design is also felt, and describes practices that cultivate designers' bodily ethical sensibility during design work.
works.description_zh: 主张设计中的伦理判断也是被感受的，并描述在设计工作中培养设计师身体性伦理感受力的实践。
works.idea_en: Ethics is not only reasoning after the fact; discomfort and care felt in the body during design are ethical signals worth attending to.
works.idea_zh: 伦理不只是事后的推理；设计中身体感到的不适与关切，就是值得注意的伦理信号。
works.method: Analysis of soma design and HRI design processes, identifying practices of felt ethical attention.
works.method_zh: 分析身体设计与人机器人交互设计过程，识别出被感受的伦理关注实践。

paper.title: Felt Ethics: Cultivating Ethical Sensibility in Design Practice

works.title: Vulnerability as an Ethical Stance in Soma Design Processes
works.description: Examines moments in soma design where designers expose their bodies and feelings, and argues that holding vulnerability with care is itself an ethical stance.
works.description_zh: 考察身体设计中设计师暴露自己的身体与感受的时刻，并主张以关怀承接脆弱性本身就是一种伦理立场。
works.idea_en: Designing from the body means being exposed; vulnerability handled with care produces both better knowledge and fairer processes.
works.idea_zh: 从身体出发做设计就意味着会暴露自己；被细心对待的脆弱性，既带来更好的知识，也带来更公平的过程。
works.method: Reflective analysis of first-person soma design processes and workshops (with Airi Lampinen).
works.method_zh: 对第一人称身体设计过程与工作坊的反思性分析（与 Airi Lampinen 合著）。

paper.title: Vulnerability as an ethical stance in soma design processes

works.title: Making New Worlds: Transformative Becomings with Soma Design
works.description: Argues that soma design changes designers and users, not only products, and reads soma design projects as ways of becoming — and of imagining other worlds for bodies.
works.description_zh: 主张身体设计改变的不只是产品，还有设计师与使用者；把身体设计项目理解为“生成”的方式，以及为身体想象另一种世界的方式。
works.idea_en: Working through the body transforms who we are; soma design is also a practice of changing how bodies are allowed to live.
works.idea_zh: 透过身体工作会改变我们是谁；身体设计也是一种改变身体被允许如何生活的实践。
works.method: Theoretical reading of soma design cases through feminist new materialism and transformation (with Rob Comber).
works.method_zh: 借女性主义新物质主义与“转化”理论解读身体设计案例（与 Rob Comber 合著）。

paper.title: Making New Worlds – Transformative Becomings with Soma Design

works.title: An Annotated Soma Design Process of the Pelvic Chair
works.description: An annotated portfolio of the whole soma design process behind the Pelvic Chair, a chair that helps people feel their pelvic floor, making each design move and its felt reason visible.
works.description_zh: 对 Pelvic Chair（一把帮助人感受盆底的椅子）整个身体设计过程所做的注释性作品集，让每一步设计选择及其身体感受上的理由都清楚可见。
works.idea_en: Soma design knowledge lives in the process; annotating that process shows how felt judgments steer the design.
works.idea_zh: 身体设计的知识存在于过程之中；为过程作注释，能展示被感受的判断如何引导设计。
works.method: Annotated portfolio method applied to a first-person soma design process (with Marianela Ciolfi Felice and Irene Kaklopoulou).
works.method_zh: 把注释性作品集方法应用于第一人称的身体设计过程（与 Marianela Ciolfi Felice、Irene Kaklopoulou 合著）。

paper.title: An Annotated Soma Design Process of the Pelvic Chair

works.title: The Somatic Turn in Human-Computer Interaction
works.description: An interactions article that names HCI's 'somatic turn': designers drawing on somatic practices to treat felt, first-person experience as central to design.
works.description_zh: 《interactions》文章，命名人机交互的“身体转向”：设计师借鉴身体修习，把被感受的第一人称经验放到设计的中心。
works.idea_en: Somatic practices give designers disciplined ways to attend to the body-mind as a whole, which is what makes soma design possible.
works.idea_zh: 身体修习为设计师提供了有纪律的方式，把身心作为整体来关注，这正是身体设计得以成立的前提。
works.method: Short overview essay linking Feldenkrais, Laban, Body-Mind Centering and other somatics to HCI methods.
works.method_zh: 简短的综述文章，把 Feldenkrais、Laban、身心平衡技法（BMC）等身心学与人机交互方法联系起来。

paper.title: The somatic turn in human-computer interaction

works.title: Soma Design and Politics of the Body
works.description: A short paper arguing that design tends to repeat dichotomies such as body-mind, male-female and emotion-thinking, and that closer somatic engagement with digital materials can help designers bypass them and counter privilege.
works.description_zh: 一篇短论文，指出设计常常重复身/心、男/女、情绪/思考等二分，而更深入地以身体投入数字材料，能帮助设计师绕开这些现成概念、对抗特权。
works.idea_en: Feeling your own body more finely also makes visible the social norms written into it; soma design has to engage those politics.
works.idea_zh: 更细致地感受自己的身体，也会让刻写在身体上的社会规范显现出来；身体设计必须面对这些政治。
works.method: Position paper reflecting on the KTH group's soma design projects through non-dualism and feminist qualities such as pluralism and participation (with Ciolfi Felice, Campo Woytuk, Kilic Afsar, Tsaknaki and Ståhl).
works.method_zh: 立场论文，从非二元立场与多元、参与等女性主义品质出发，反思 KTH 团队的身体设计项目（与 Ciolfi Felice、Campo Woytuk、Kilic Afsar、Tsaknaki、Ståhl 合著）。

paper.title: Soma Design and Politics of the Body

works.title: Five Political Provocations for Soma Design: A Relational Perspective on Emotion and Politics
works.description: Five provocations on the politics of soma design — ways of knowing, the self, felt ethics and right action, the pursuit of happiness, and justice and the emotional labour of transformation.
works.description_zh: 关于身体设计之政治的五条“挑衅”：认识方式、自我、被感受的伦理与正当行动、对幸福的追求，以及正义与转化中的情绪劳动。
works.idea_en: Felt experience is shaped between bodies and by society; designing for the soma therefore means designing within politics.
works.idea_zh: 被感受的经验在身体之间、由社会塑造；因此为身体设计，就是在政治之中设计。
works.method: Conceptual paper combining soma design, political theory and Sara Ahmed's The Cultural Politics of Emotion (with Pasko Kisić-Merino and Pedro Sanches).
works.method_zh: 结合身体设计、政治理论与 Sara Ahmed《情绪的文化政治》写成的概念性论文（与 Pasko Kisić-Merino、Pedro Sanches 合著）。

paper.title: Five Political Provocations for Soma Design: A Relational Perspective on Emotion and Politics

works.title: Estrangement through Silence
works.description: Over four workshops across 18 months, mostly outdoors, the authors kept long periods of shared silence; the collective silence worked as an estrangement method that revealed how people and things shape one another.
works.description_zh: 在一年半里的四次工作坊中（多在户外），作者们长时间共同保持静默；这种集体静默成为一种陌生化方法，揭示了人与物如何彼此构成。
works.idea_en: Silence is not an absence but a presence full of sound and contact; shared silence tunes designers to themselves, each other and the environment.
works.idea_zh: 静默不是缺席，而是充满声音与接触的在场；共同的静默让设计师与自己、彼此和环境调谐。
works.method: Four first-person workshops with prolonged collective silence during activities such as cooking and designing (with Pedro Sanches and Vasiliki Tsaknaki).
works.method_zh: 四次第一人称工作坊，在烹饪、设计等活动中长时间保持集体静默（与 Pedro Sanches、Vasiliki Tsaknaki 合著）。

paper.title: Estrangement through Silence

works.title: Voicing Discomfort, Communicating Breakdowns: Design Exploration of Felt Ethics in a Body-Based Workshop
works.description: A soma-design workshop with interaction designers that explores ethics through the discomfort felt in interpersonal bodily interaction, and how participants make that discomfort shared.
works.description_zh: 一个面向交互设计师的身体设计工作坊：通过人与人身体互动中的不适来探讨伦理，并观察参与者如何让这种不适被共同承认。
works.idea_en: Ethical breakdowns are first felt as discomfort; giving people ways to voice it keeps bodies safe and design honest.
works.idea_zh: 伦理上的裂缝最先表现为身体的不适；给人说出它的方式，能保护身体，也让设计保持诚实。
works.method: Body-based workshop grounded in soma design and the ethics of care, analysed from video recordings and post-workshop interviews (with Arife Dila Demir, Joo Young Park and Rob Comber).
works.method_zh: 以身体设计与关怀伦理为基础的工作坊，依据录像与事后访谈进行分析（与 Arife Dila Demir、Joo Young Park、Rob Comber 合著）。

paper.title: Voicing Discomfort, Communicating Breakdowns: Design Exploration of Felt Ethics in a Body-Based Workshop

works.title: Change and Be Changed: Looking Back at 10 Years of the Soma Design Research Program
works.description: A TOCHI retrospective on ten years of the soma design research program: what its methods, prototypes and concepts achieved, and how doing it changed the designers themselves.
works.description_zh: TOCHI 回顾文章，总结身体设计研究纲领的十年：它的方法、原型与概念取得了什么，以及这项工作如何改变了设计师自己。
works.idea_en: Soma design changes the designer as much as the design; a research program built on the felt body must account for that change.
works.idea_zh: 身体设计改变设计师，不亚于改变设计；建立在被感受的身体之上的研究纲领，必须把这种改变算进去。
works.method: Retrospective analysis of design examples and concepts, assessing the program's generativity, transferability and scope.
works.method_zh: 对设计案例与概念的回顾性分析，从生成力、可迁移性与范围三方面评估该纲领。

paper.title: Change and Be Changed: Looking Back at 10 Years of the Soma Design Research Program
